# Adult Sailing Programs

## Adult Sailing Programs
Sailing programs for adults and families: private lessons, flexible scheduling and courses for all ability levels. Family programs require one adult to accompany youth ages 12-17. Youth programs for ages 8-15 are on the [Youth Programs Page](https://www.cwb.org/youth-programs-camps).

### Already know how to sail and want to schedule a sailing check out?
[Learn more here.](https://www.cwb.org/slu-checkout)

![Blanchard_Class_29Sep12_MReinitz+(18+of+22).jpg](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1675208831085-MZUL7V2DGT7K9HGD36RB/Blanchard_Class_29Sep12_MReinitz%2B%2818%2Bof%2B22%29.jpg)

## Learn to Sail
### [US SAILING BASIC KEELBOAT CERTIFICATION](https://www.cwb.org/us-sailing-basic-keelboat-certification)
A 22-hour [US Sailing Basic Keelboat Certification](https://www.ussailing.org/education/adult/certification-courses-endorsements/basic-keelboat/) course for keelboats under 27 feet in winds up to 15 knots. No prerequisites.
### [SailNOW! LEARN TO SAIL](https://www.cwb.org/sailnow-learn-to-sail)
A one-month intensive: shore school followed by 12 hours of on-the-lake lessons.
### [PRIVATE SAILING LESSONS](https://www.cwb.org/private-sailing-lessons)
One-on-one lessons for beginners, refreshers and rental checkouts; add 2-3 friends or family.
### [SAFE POWERBOAT hANDLING](https://www.cwb.org/safe-powerboat-handling)
A 16-hour on-the-water course for motorboats up to 26 feet, US Coast Guard and NASBLA approved.
### [DROP-IN SHORE SCHOOL](https://www.cwb.org/dropin-shore-school)
A 2-hour introduction to sailing basics and terminology.

## Improving Your Sailing Skills
### [SAILING SKILL BUILDING CLINIC](https://www.cwb.org/sailing-skills-clinic)
A low-cost, repeatable clinic, limited to 3 people per week. Not intended for brand-new sailors.

## More to Learn & Just for Fun
### [2026 Summer Racing Series](https://www.cwb.org/summer-racing-series)
A friendly race series with random team and boat assignments; prizes for the top 3 sailors.
### [Small Boat Navigation](https://www.cwb.org/small-boat-navigation)
A 10-hour, two-weekend course on charts, tides and currents for Puget Sound.
### [Small Boat Cruising Clinic](https://www.cwb.org/small-boat-cruising)
A 4-hour introduction to cruising in boats under 22 feet: trip planning, safety gear and Salish Sea destinations.

## Testimonies
Genbook-verified reviews praising the instructors and the friendly, safety-focused atmosphere.
